title: Two digital low-pass filters
intro: Choose a filter and its size, and watch which frequencies pass and how fast the output follows a step. The signal is sampled at 8 kHz.
fcLabel: Cutoff frequency of the first-order filter
att1kLabel: Gain at 1 kHz (the tone to remove)
pass300Label: Gain at 300 Hz (the band to keep)
f3Label: Frequency where the gain is 3 dB down
gainTitle: Gain of the filter against frequency
stepTitle: Output after the input jumps from 0 to 1
checkTone: The 1 kHz tone is at least 20 dB down.
